title: Article 43 — Living wage, etc., for workers

content.overview: Article 43 directs the State to endeavour to secure, by suitable legislation or economic organisation or in any other way, to all workers — agricultural, industrial or otherwise — work, a living wage, conditions of work ensuring a decent standard of life and full enjoyment of leisure and social and cultural opportunities, and in particular to promote cottage industries on an individual or co-operative basis in rural areas.
content.glance: Living wage and decent standard of life for all workers; promote cottage industries in rural areas.
content.study:
Article 43 covers living wage, decent standard of life, leisure and cultural opportunities for all workers, and promotion of rural cottage industries. Article 43A (workers’ participation in management) is a related insertion.

Examination: living wage; decent standard of life; cottage industries; all workers (agricultural, industrial or otherwise).
